units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 4:8">B. Bath. IV, 8</cite> <he>ח׳ שאינו מורכב</he> a carob-tree which has not yet been ingrafted (bears no fruit).

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 35:6">Lev. R. s. 35</cite>, a. e. (play on <he>חרב תאכלו</he>, <cite ref="Isaiah 1:20">Is. I, 20</cite>) <he>ח׳ תֹּאכְלוּ</he> (some ed. <he>וחרבין</he>, corr. acc.) ye shall eat carobs (live in poverty); a. fr.

senses.gloss: a variety of beans, the pods of which resemble the carob, v. חֲרוּבָא.
